chunks: And in the narration of Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād, from Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"Whoever recites a line of poetry on the day of al-Jumuʿah, that is his share from that day."

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: the narrator Zurārah in the chain of transmission

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about reciting poetry on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith discourages occupying the day of al-Jumuʿah with poetry instead of the acts and attentiveness appropriate to its sanctity. It indicates that a person's portion of that blessed day may be diminished by engagement in such distraction.
